name: 診断情報を添付する選択カード
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0045. Image1 ORIGINAL source is authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Image2 is the previous generated edit target. Image3 is secondary mock for locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Edit prior LH07-0045. Change density and thumbnail frame only. Keep exact two strings スクリーンショット and 情報を隠す・強調する, Meiryo Regular14/24 and12/16, white card, thin border, forestgreen check selection, original screenshot photo/feed/sharemenu colors and crop. Maintain card width358 but reduce height69 to60: top/bottom white padding to8, no extra gaps; do not shrink text. Reduce selected circle28 to20 while preserving white check geometry, leftinset10 and8px gap before labels. Thumbnail70x52, alignedright with4px vertical inset. Remove independent rounded frame/border around thumbnail: it is source screenshot clipped as a plain rectangle at right, outer card provides only border. Preserve original photo/feed and partial share-menu artwork; no new details, badges, row or caption. Closecrop around actualcard, compactrealUIproportions, no oversized surrounding whitespace. Do not thicken labels or rearrange text.
reviewNotes: 2つの日本語文言・Regularの役割・選択丸と白チェック・元サムネイルの写真/共有メニュー構成を目視確認。丸と余白を縮小し独立した見本枠を除去。外側16px包装なし。358幅換算の画像カード高は概算67で目標60との差が残るため厳密寸法一致や原画ピクセル同一性は未受入。実アプリ/ネイティブ挙動の証明ではない。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
